sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.tag.sentry.de: Arm the Mechanical Arm with powerful weapons from TacZ
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.sentry_arm_in: The Sentry Mechanical Arm is a powerful firepower platform.
Hold a TaCZ gun and press its Interact key (default O) to equip the sentry.
Right-click to attach an Ammo Box. Sneak-right-click to remove it.
Once connected to rotational power, it will activate and automatically target all hostile mobs.
Stationary sentries can store kill loot and converted experience in the container below.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.sentry_arm_su: If you want the Sentry Mechanical Arm to have sustained firepower...
You need to build a logistical supply chain for it.
Mechanical Arms and Hoppers can feed ammo to the Sentry Mechanical Arm.
Mechanical Arms will automatically extract empty Ammo Boxes.
A Deployer holding ammo can reload the Ammo Box beneath it.
Thus, the Sentry Mechanical Arm receives a ceaseless stream of firepower.
By default, the Sentry Mechanical Arm only attacks hostile mobs.
Using the Fire Control Console, you can specify specific targets.
Right-click one of them with a Wrench...
This establishes a connection between them.
While using a Spyglass, hold the Permit in the offhand and middle-click to record a target.
Deliver the Permit/List to the Fire Control Console...
Blacklist selects targets to attack; Whitelist selects targets to protect.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.sentry_arm_mo: Sentry Mechanical Arms can be used on moving contraptions.
Sentries retain their rotational speed when assembled into a contraption.
Sentry Mechanical Arms will use ammunition from containers within the contraption.
Fire Controllers on moving contraptions remain functional.
item.sentrymechanicalarm.fire_control_cl: -Entities in the list will be attacked

message.sentrymechanicalarm.blacklist_de: Only attack entities on the list

item.sentrymechanicalarm.empty_casing.de: Used to reload ammunition of the same caliber.

sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.casing_formin: Right-click the mold to select a casing caliber.
Give the configured mold to a Deployer.
The Deployer uses the mold to shape metal into matching casings.
Both new and recovered casings can be reloaded.
The mold is not consumed. Retrieve it to select another caliber.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.casing_reload: Use a Mechanical Mixer to turn gunpowder into propellant.
Use pipes to supply the Spout with propellant.
The Spout fills casings placed beneath it with propellant.
Some ammunition also requires Deployers to add solid ingredients.
Finally, press the casing to complete a round.
Larger charges require multiple filling steps.
Craft an unfinished casing on its own to recover the empty casing.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.casing_collec: Place a Casing Collector next to a Sentry Mechanical Arm.
Casings produced by firing enter the collector directly.
Use Hoppers or other logistics components to extract the contents.
When collectors are full, the remaining items drop onto the ground.
On contraptions, sentries use collectors on their own structure.
Players collect their casings into their inventory by default.
Casings that do not fit drop beside the player.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.sentry_depot_: Attach matching Ammo Boxes to the sentry.
Matching ammunition from adjacent depots replenishes the boxes.
Sentries can also draw ammunition from depots on their contraption.
Check the sentry supply hints if it runs out of ammunition.
Keep the depot stocked through logistics to maintain the supply.
sentrymechanicalarm.ponder.sentry_target: Link the Fire Control and sentry with a Wrench.
Blacklist selects targets to attack; Whitelist selects targets to protect.
Sneak-right-click with the Permit to add yourself to its list.
Sneak-right-click a Fire Control with the scope to bind it.
While using the scope, left-click an entity to focus linked sentries.
Middle-click marks a position for explosive weapons to attack.
Sentries still require rotational power, ammunition and a target within range.
item.sentrymechanicalarm.casing_mold.too: Allows a Deployer to form metal into _casings of a selected caliber_.
Processes matching metal ingredients. The mold _is not consumed_.
block.sentrymechanicalarm.casing_collect: Stores _casings_ produced by Sentry Mechanical Arms.
Receives shot byproducts automatically. When full, _remaining items drop_.
Receives byproducts from sentries on the _same structure_.
